title: 第七章 天书上的一剑第八章 师妹害我
lines: 这一声直冲云霄，在天地间回荡。
于是，天上的乌云渐渐散开，天地骤然变得明亮，让人心生敬畏。
一道磅礴的力量、无视缓缓落下的雪花，如天穹上有一道神光落下，静静地落在东方霓裳的身上。
于是那有些清瘦的身躯，瞬间变得圣洁，高远。
老道士感受到了这一道恐怖的力量，正在凝聚，于是往后再退一步。
浑浊的目光瞬间变得清澈。
如一座高山，伫立在雪地。
一刹那，天空中簌簌落下的雪花，被一道寒风刮向如山一般的老道士！
风雪如刀亦如剑，在东方霓裳手掌轻拍之下，化为漫天的灵剑，往老道士斩去！
这一刻，她甚至用上了天书上的神功！
而老道士的身影，却在这一瞬间变得虚幻起来。
就像是眼睛里蒙了一层雾气，看不清眼前的一幕似的。
给人一种雾里看花，似假还真的错觉。
于是，东方霓裳清秀的容颜上，终于有了一丝凝重的神情。
她有必胜的信心。
却没有厮杀的经验。
事实上，她是昆仑的天骄，这么多年来她几乎都是深居简出，甚至没有经历过生死历练。
就像是一枝绽放在昆仑深处的雪莲一样。
无人见到她的美丽，她也没有与外界，甚至同门的师兄厮杀过。
今日，当她看到这漫天雪花化剑，忽然浅浅一笑。
她伸出手，仿佛在风雪中折了一枝寒梅。
那漫天雪花，便是她信手拈花，自天穹之上往人间洒落的花瓣！
漫天风雪甚至有一抹淡淡的冷香。
往老道士迎面而来，问他要一个输赢的结果。
老道士看着她自信的面容。
原本想要退让的他，突然间却改变了心意，不能退。
于是，漫天雪花突然呆住了！
寒风呼啸，她们要往前斩落，落在老道士的道袍上，给那老家伙一个教训。
只是，就在她们落下的一刹那，面前出现一道透明的屏障，如一面若有若无的水雾，挡下漫天斩来的雪花。
雪花落在这道屏障上，被水雾瞬间融化，化为了雾气。
便是东方霓裳使出天书上的神功。
也无法破开老道士的世界。
王贤看呆了！
澹台小雪看呆了！
content_en:
This sound shot straight into the sky and echoed between heaven and earth.
Then, the dark clouds in the sky gradually dispersed, and the sky and the earth suddenly became bright, which made people feel awe-inspiring.
A majestic force ignored the slowly falling snowflakes, like a divine light falling from the sky, and fell quietly on Dongfang Nishang's body.
So that somewhat thin body instantly became holy and lofty.
The old Taoist priest felt that this terrifying power was gathering, so he took a step back.
The cloudy eyes instantly became clear.
Like a high mountain standing in the snow.
In an instant, the snowflakes falling in the sky were blown by a cold wind towards the mountain-like old Taoist priest!
The wind and snow were as sharp as a sword. Under the gentle pat of Dongfang Nishang's palm, they turned into spiritual swords that filled the sky and slashed at the old Taoist priest!
At this moment, she even used the magical power in the heavenly book!
But the figure of the old Taoist priest became illusory at this moment.
It was as if there was a layer of fog in his eyes and he couldn't clearly see the scene in front of him.
It gives people the illusion of seeing flowers in a fog, seeming fake but still real.
As a result, Dongfang Nishang's delicate face finally had a dignified expression.
She has the confidence to win.
But he has no experience in fighting.
In fact, she is Kunlun's genius. She has lived in seclusion for so many years and has not even experienced life and death.
Just like a snow lotus blooming deep in Kunlun.
No one has seen her beauty, and she has never fought with the outside world, or even her fellow disciples.
Today, when she saw the snowflakes in the sky turning into swords, she suddenly smiled slightly.
She stretched out her hand, as if she had broken off a winter plum in the wind and snow.
The snowflakes all over the sky are the petals she picked up and sprinkled from the sky to the world!
There is even a faint cold fragrance in the wind and snow.
The old Taoist priest came to meet him and asked him for a winning or losing result.
The old Taoist priest looked at her confident face.
He originally wanted to give in, but suddenly changed his mind and could not back down.
Then, the snowflakes all over the sky suddenly froze!
The cold wind howled, and they wanted to chop forward and fall on the old Taoist priest's robe, teaching the old guy a lesson.
However, the moment they fell, a transparent barrier appeared in front of them, like a vague mist, blocking the snowflakes coming from the sky.
The snowflakes fell on this barrier and were instantly melted by the water mist, turning into mist.
It was Dongfang Nishang who used the magical power written in the heavenly book.
Nor can it break the world of the old Taoist priest.
Wang Xian was stunned!
Tantai Xiaoxue was stunned!
title_en: Chapter 7: A Sword in the Book of Heaven Chapter 8: Junior Sister Harmed Me
